title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode8 What's Amazing About You

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_leoneed_op4
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It got so late while I was in that instrument shop.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I need to get home and practice.
Also, if I have time, I want to start working on a new Miku song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, that's our song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's being played on that billboard again.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(This still feels a little weird...
I mean, that's my voice being played here.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, it's that song...

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this one!
It's that Miku song!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Wait a second. Miku isn't the one singing...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
It's by a band called Leo/need, right?
That explains why they have their own version.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
This band's version is also really good. I might give it a better listen later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, they're talking about us...
That's kind of nice.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Still...)
<It's hard not to feel embarrassed hearing them talk about us like that, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I came to chat.
Are you all done with practice?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. But is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, sort of... Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is something wrong, Ichika...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You had this complicated expression on your face.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's nothing serious.
But...
Recording Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shindo's Voice
rows.Line:
<Are you ready, Ms. Hoshino?
We'll start from the top if you are.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes...! I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(They want the vocals recorded separately...
Plus, this is my first time singing in front of sound engineers. I'm getting really nervous.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But this is our debut song...
It's going to be the first one that the masses hear.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We need to make it as good as we can...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My voice is looping back through these headphones...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(What do I do?
I'm starting to get really lost.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Can we try that again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It happened again. I'm having trouble singing the way I normally do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to really project my voice here, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo's Voice
rows.Line: <Is this a bit too different from what your band usually does?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I'm having trouble singing the way I normally do, and listening to my voice as I do this seems to be playing a role in that...

rows.Speaker: Shindo's Voice
rows.Line:
<Right.
It's natural to feel uncomfortable since it's your first time doing this.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo's Voice
rows.Line: <But as far as I can tell, you are singing the way you usually do.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes, really. I know you're nervous, but try to remain confident.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Nice work, Ms. Hoshino.
What did you think of your first recording session?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a lot of trouble singing the way I wanted...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Would you like to do some extra takes...?
No one else is scheduled to use this place, so we don't mind sticking around for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Then...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: No, let's stop at our scheduled time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I understand why you wish to continue.
You're recording your debut song, so you want everyone to hear you at your best.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But you've raised the bar very high for yourself because you're so motivated right now. Which probably means you're not going to like anything you record.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's extremely important to want to sing and sound a particular way.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But you really are doing better than you realize, Ms. Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, let's do one more take and call things there.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Regardless of what happens, that's it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Let me hear you sing, Ms. Hoshino.
Show me everything you've got right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I sang with everything I had and was told that it was my best take...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But a part of me keeps wondering if I could have done better here and there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is what I'm capable of right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to accept that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, things didn't go as planned when Saki and I wrote that song. And the same goes for the recording session...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been stumbling quite a lot as we take on new challenges...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But in order for us to keep moving forward, I have to accept where I am and find ways to improve.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're so strong, Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? No, I really don't think I said anything praiseworthy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I think it was.
Especially the part about accepting where you are right now. That isn't easy.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I do.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're not running away from your faults. You're trying to move forward by facing them head-on.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I believe your ability to do so is one of your best qualities, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because you're so strong, I'm certain that you'll be able to propel yourself even further forward.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Naturally, the others as well.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Actually...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Those sorts of feelings may be behind that new area appearing.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What new area?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Come to SEKAI.
There's something I'd like to show you.>
